preconditions.expression: all(c in {'b', 'w'} for c in stdin.strip())
preconditions.description: The input string consists only of the characters 'b' and 'w'.
The length of the input string is between 1 and 100,000 (inclusive).

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the maximum possible zebra length, which must be at least 1 and at most the length of the input string.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == max(max_alternating_subsequence(s) for s in all_possible_reversals(stdin.strip()))
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum length of a contiguous alternating subsequence ('b' followed by 'w' or vice versa) that can be obtained by performing zero or more split-and-reverse operations on the input string.
